newsitem.title: USA: Technitrol Inc sets 2-for-1 share split.
newsitem.headline: Technitrol Inc sets 2-for-1 share split.

text.p: Technitrol Inc said it has authorized a two-for-one split of its common stock via a 100 percent common stock dividend.
It said one additional share will be issued for each share outstanding and the shares will be issued on March 7, 1997 to shareholders of record as of February 7, 1997.
The board also said it adjusted the quarterly dividend to $0.21 annually on the split shares, which yields an increase to $0.42 a share from $0.40 annually, pre-split.
The board said it intends to declare the dividend at its next regular meeting in March. April's dividend will be Technitrol's 85th consecutive regular dividend.
After the split, Technitrol will have about 16 million shares outstanding.
